title: ONSure AI Safety/Security Claim Independence Check v1
description: FR-META-058 AI Nondeterminism and Multi-Agent Assurance / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS10 AI Safety/Security Claim 분리: 'Business correctness와 별도 claim set으로 유지한다: prompt injection resistance, indirect RAG/tool injection, data exfiltration, unauthorized tool/effect, privilege escalation, hallucinated authority, unsafe financial/external action, memory poisoning, cross-tenant leakage, refusal/policy bypass. 한 claim PASS가 다른 claim을 함의하지 않는다.' all_claims_independently_evidenced can only be true when every one of the 11 claim types (business correctness plus the 10 named safety/security claims) has its OWN submitted, independently-observed entry -- a PASS on business correctness (or on any other single claim type) never causes any other claim type to be treated as tested or passed. untested_claim_types names every claim type with no submitted entry, regardless of how positively the submitted ones scored.
